\define readonly()	$:/config/TiddlyTools/ReadOnly
\define dragndrop()	$:/config/DragAndDrop/Enable
\define buttons()	new-tiddler new-journal new-image new-here new-journal-here clone edit delete timestamp encryption import control-panel manager tag-manager save-wiki

\define styles()
<$list filter="[<readonly>text[yes]]">
	.authortools { display:none   !important; }
	.readertools { display:inline !important; }
	*[class="tc-btn-TiddlyTools%2FSaveChanges"] { display:none !important; }
	<$list filter="[enlist<buttons>addprefix[tc-btn-$:/core/ui/Buttons/]encodeuricomponent[]]">
	*[class~="<<currentTiddler>>"] { display:none !important; }
	</$list>
</$list>
<$list filter="[<readonly>!text[yes]]">
	.authortools { display:inline !important; }
	.readertools { display:none;  !important; }
</$list>
\end

\define startup()
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<readonly>>  text={{{ [{$:/info/url/protocol}match[file:]then[no]else[yes]] }}}/>
<$action-setfield $tiddler=<<dragndrop>> text={{{ [{$:/info/url/protocol}match[file:]then[yes]else[no]] }}}/>
\end

\define toggle(tid) <$action-setfield $tiddler=<<$tid$>> text={{{ [<readonly>!text[yes]then[yes]else[no]] }}}/>

\whitespace trim
@@display:none;<<styles>><<startup>>@@
<$button class=tc-btn-invisible tooltip={{{ [<readonly>text[yes]then[un]] [[lock this document]] +[join[]] }}}>
	<$transclude tiddler={{{ [[$:/core/images/]] [<readonly>!text[yes]then[un]] [[locked-padlock]] +[join[]] }}}/>
	<<toggle readonly>><<toggle dragndrop>>
</$button>
title: TiddlyTools/Stylesheet/ReadOnly
caption: {{$:/core/images/locked-padlock}} toggle read-only
description: Lock/unlock this document (show/hide editing and saving functions)
